object_description: two freely placed buildings with flowing connecting spaces
design_condition: The differentiated volumes are placed as a cohesive complex with low base buildings mediating to the pedestrian level, while the schoolyard, street, and garden sides organize access and outdoor activity.

positive.statement: The project takes up the landscape qualities of the district and integrates the large building volumes well into the small-scale context.
Differentiated height grading spatially relates the buildings and creates a pleasant transition to the pedestrian level.
The independent architectural expression integrates the existing school building and creates a strong identity as a cohesive public facility.
The well-lit central room organizes the classrooms and group rooms efficiently.
Flexible room dividers allow varied spatial constellations and different educational concepts.
The interior atmosphere is inviting, with simple and robust materials suggesting a pleasant indoor climate.
The foyer and stage area extend the hall into an attractive space continuum open to its surroundings.
Pedestrian routes, deliveries, and parking facilities are well placed and separated.
The buildings have efficient supporting structures, low space requirements, and a lean energy concept.
The proposal is convincing because of its precise integration into the small-scale context.

negative.statement: The kindergarten outdoor spaces must be tailored more closely to operational needs and are limited in size in some places.
The outdoor areas are only partially visible from the kindergarten rooms.
The indirect connection between the equipment room and the gymnasium must be questioned from an operational perspective.
The dimensions of the stage access must be checked.
The glass portion of the building envelopes and the interior design should be optimized in the interests of economy.
The multi-purpose hall foyer is volumetrically very spacious and offers a target for optimization.
